correctness.rationale: For the exact scalar quadratic specialization, the proximal map is explicit and both source curvature measures reduce exactly to \(a\) times the squared step. This makes the curvature test equivalent to \(a t_k>c_0\), its contraction branch an exact reset \(t_{k+1}=c_1/a\), and the objective ratio exactly \((1-a t_k)^2\). The initialization and strict inequality give \(t_1=(1+\gamma_0)c_0/a\), proving the displayed unbounded transient factor for admissible summable sequences. The safety cap follows from the exact scalar nonincrease condition \(0<a t\le2\). An exact-rational checker replays representative instances.

value.rationale: This is a complete and motivated boundary analysis of the source's adaptive rule on the canonical strongly convex quadratic. It separates post-hoc curvature repair from pre-step safety, gives the exact repair \(t_{k+1}=c_1/a\), proves that the stated theoretical inputs allow unbounded finite transient amplification even after an initially decreasing step, and supplies the sharp scalar expansion cap \(\gamma'_k\le2/c_0-1\) that prevents such increases. The fact directly explains why the source's descent theorem is eventual rather than all-iterate and gives a concrete safeguard criterion.
